title: Event Loop Processing Signature Mismatches
body:
In [§ 8.1.6.3 "Processing Model"](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#event-loop-processing-model), as part of step 7, several external algorithms are called, passing the timestamp *now* each time.

Four of these algorithms do not take a timestamp as an argument. This argument should therefore be removed from the algorithm calls.


### Substep 7
> For each fully active `Document` in *docs*, run the resize steps for that `Document`, passing in *now* as the timestamp.
 
The definition of the [resize steps](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#document-run-the-resize-steps) begins with the header
 
> When asked to **run the resize steps** for a `Document` *doc*, run these steps:

### Substep 8
> For each fully active `Document` in *docs*, run the scroll steps for that `Document`, passing in *now* as the timestamp.

The definition of the [scroll steps](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#document-run-the-scroll-steps) begins with the header
 
> When asked to **run the scroll steps** for a `Document` *doc*, run these steps:

### Substep 9
> For each fully active `Document` in docs, evaluate media queries and report changes for that `Document`, passing in *now* as the timestamp.

The definition of the steps to [evaluate media queries and report changes](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#evaluate-media-queries-and-report-changes) begins with the header

> When asked to **evaluate media queries and report changes** for a `Document` *doc*, run these steps:

### Substep 11
> For each fully active `Document` in *docs*, run the fullscreen steps for that `Document`, passing in *now* as the timestamp.

The definition of the [fullscreen steps](https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#run-the-fullscreen-steps) begins with the header:
